note: Sudan, read on 2026-10-31 on the site of the Embassy of the Republic of the Sudan in Berlin (sudanembassy.de, its visa services page), which carries the opening of an official decision on a health card for those entering through embassies to study in Sudan: issued under Article 71 of the Police Act 2008 read with Article 56(2) of the Foreigners' Affairs Regulation of 2020, after cases of hepatitis among applicants for residence for the purpose of study at Sudanese universities and institutes (written as one study route). The decision's full text (a scanned PDF) wasn't read, and the page names no other residence route, fee, term, renewal or work right. The Foreigners' Affairs Regulation 2020 itself and the Ministry of Interior's passports and immigration directorate (immigration.gov.sd) weren't reached.

sources.title: Embassy of the Republic of the Sudan in Berlin: Visa services to Sudan
sources.said: الكرت الصحي لطالبي الدخول عبر السفارات بغرض الدراسة بالسودان عملاً بالسلطات المخولة لي بموجب المادة (71) من قانون الشرطة 2008 مقرؤة مع المادة (2/56) من لائحة شئون الأجانب للعام 2020م وتفادياً للسلبيات التي نتجت عن ظهور حالات الإصابة بالكبد الوبائي عند طالبي الإقامة بغرض الدراسة بالجامعات والمعاهد السودانية
